rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) names the item. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow printed order). Schedule 1 rows map by the block letter, the printed effective-year caption and the Export/Taxable/Due column headers. Part III and Part IV amounts pair the 11-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Part III date combs (tax agent issue/expiry) stay blank. Rows printed for 2024 onwards and the novel tobacco rows have no layout key and stay blank. Since #113: the 2022 sheet's item 6 vapor rows (XT170/XT180, 2022-2023) take the model's 7A/7B keys by ATC, date and rate; the Others rows map by the page 3 column headers; Items 7, 10, 11 and the page 2/3 TIN print from derived: keys of Form2200TDraft::to_print_field_map (place names, not PSGC codes). The 2020-2021 and XT165 keys have no printed row and are listed in not_joined. date_joins split each payment-row date (MM/DD/YYYY) across the MM, DD and YYYY combs of the row whose Agency/Number/Amount joins share its suffix.
